name: rlsp-yaml
description: YAML language support powered by rlsp-yaml

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The rlsp-yaml.server.path setting is ignored in untrusted workspaces. Only the bundled server binary is used.

rlsp-yaml.customTags.description: Custom YAML tags to recognize. Each entry is a tag name (e.g. "!include") or a tag name followed by a type annotation (e.g. "!include scalar", "!Ref mapping", "!Sub sequence"). Tags with a type annotation emit a tagTypeMismatch warning when the node structure does not match.

rlsp-yaml.kubernetesVersion.patternErrorMessage: Use "master" or a version such as 1.29.0 (digits only, without a leading "v"). Any other value falls back to "master".
rlsp-yaml.kubernetesVersion.description: Kubernetes schema version to use: "master" or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH such as 1.29.0. Any other value falls back to "master".

rlsp-yaml.formatSingleQuote.description: Use single quotes in formatted output

rlsp-yaml.formatPreserveQuotes.description: Preserve the source quote style of scalar values during formatting

rlsp-yaml.formatBracketSpacing.description: Add spaces inside flow braces: { a: 1 } vs {a: 1}. Default true.

rlsp-yaml.formatEnforceBlockStyle.description: Convert all flow-style collections ([...], {...}) to block style when formatting. When false (default), the formatter preserves the original style.

rlsp-yaml.flowStyle.description: Severity of flow-style diagnostics (flowMap/flowSeq). 'off' disables them, 'warning' shows a warning squiggle, 'error' marks them as errors.

rlsp-yaml.duplicateKeys.description: Severity of duplicate key diagnostics. 'off' disables detection, 'warning' shows a warning, 'error' (default) marks as errors.

rlsp-yaml.formatRemoveDuplicateKeys.description: Remove duplicate mapping keys when formatting. Keeps the last occurrence (YAML spec behavior). When false (default), duplicate keys are preserved.

rlsp-yaml.formatIndentSequences.description: Indent block sequences under mapping keys. When true (default), sequences are indented: `key:\n  - item`. When false, sequences start at the key's indent level: `key:\n- item`.

rlsp-yaml.httpProxy.description: HTTP proxy URL for schema fetching

rlsp-yaml.colorDecorators.description: Show color decorators for CSS color values

rlsp-yaml.schemas.description: Maps schema URLs to the files they apply to. A value is one glob or an array of up to 32 globs. A glob starting with "!" excludes files. A leading "/" is ignored, and a glob matches at any directory level, as if it began with "**/". At least one glob must not start with "!" and must not be empty. An entry that breaks these rules, or a glob longer than 256 bytes, is ignored by the server with a warning, as are the entries beyond 512 globs in total.

rlsp-yaml.yamlVersion.description: YAML specification version. Affects formatting quoting rules and YAML 1.1 compatibility diagnostics. When set to 1.1, diagnostics for YAML 1.1 boolean and octal values are suppressed.

rlsp-yaml.validate.description: Enable or disable all YAML diagnostics.

rlsp-yaml.formatEnable.description: Enable the built-in YAML formatter. When false, textDocument/formatting, textDocument/rangeFormatting, and textDocument/onTypeFormatting return no edits. Diagnostics, hover, completion, and code actions remain active. See docs/configuration.md for interop notes.

rlsp-yaml.maxItemsComputed.description: Maximum number of document symbols and folding ranges the server returns per document.

rlsp-yaml.formatRespectEditorconfig.description: When false, ignore .editorconfig files for YAML formatting. Defaults to true.
